validation.clock_dots_q20_limitation: The current source produces one dot, then raises FAULT_GRAPH_ENV_COLLISION after two restarts at q=20; clock-dots is deployed with q=5
validation.known_baseline_parity_failure: check_syn_sim.py --fibonacci-only differs from the newer Concrete sharing policy at commit 212, address 11, on the unchanged production baseline and preceding v5 candidate; the present revision separately verifies the semantic result 8

previous_physical_attempt.outcome: Four dots followed by a fault; JTAG SAMPLE and user observation confirm LD6=1, LD4=0. The source model reproduces the same four-dot stop as CONTROL_UNDERFLOW in inline IO-THEN sequencing. Candidate is not qualified for sustained operation.
previous_physical_attempt.source_regression: IO-THEN with a reconstructed inline NIL value has no child JOIN frame; the existing JOIN sequencing path incorrectly restores a nonexistent frame.
previous_physical_attempt.focused_old_rtl_failure: The inline IO-THEN fixture also raises core CONTROL_UNDERFLOW=4 on the old lowered circuit after 193324 board cycles, before UART output.

supervisor.behavior: Finish q=0 reconstruction, copy reachable residual spines, relocate APP/RBLOCK links, restart the dedicated reducer; CLOCK and UART never refresh the budget
